headlines.title: Trump threatens to pull Todd Blanche’s AG nomination until after GOP holdouts leave office
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday threatened to withdraw Todd Blanche’s nomination to be attorney general until two Republican senators who have expressed concerns about Blanche leave office in January.

headlines.title: DOJ holds first-ever hearing of ‘Alien Terrorist Removal Court,’ created in 1996
headlines.description: DOJ holds first-ever hearing of ‘Alien Terrorist Removal Court,’ created in 1996

headlines.title: Democrat Mandela Barnes drops out of the Wisconsin governor’s race
headlines.description: Former Lt. Gov. Mandela Barnes said Thursday that he is dropping out of the Democratic race for governor in Wisconsin.

headlines.title: States push DHS to explain its noncitizen voter claims
headlines.description: State officials are pushing back on the Department of Homeland Security’s claims that it found tens of thousands of noncitizens on their voter rolls, asking the department to explain how it arrived at its conclusion.

headlines.title: Trump says he could pull Blanche's attorney general nomination until GOP holdouts leave
headlines.description: In a post on social media, President Trump threatened to pull acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination to serve permanently in the role until two Senate Republicans who are withholding their support leave office next year. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports from Capitol Hill on why the senators oppose advancing Blanche's nomination to the full Senate.

headlines.title: Republicans Delay Key Vote on Todd Blanche’s DOJ Nomination
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s pick to lead the Department of Justice could be in jeopardy after Republicans postponed a key vote set for Thursday on Todd Blanche’s nomination amid a showdown with two GOP senators. NBC’s Kelly O’Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Anthony Fauci Invokes Fifth Amendment at Heated Senate Hearing
headlines.description: At a contentious hearing on Capitol Hill Wednesday, Dr. Anthony Fauci refused to answer repeated questions about his handling of the COVID-19 pandemic, invoking the Fifth Amendment more than 100 times. Now, Republicans are threatening to hold him in contempt of Congress. NBC’s Monica Alba reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: U.S. strikes Iran after Trump reportedly issues menacing new threat
headlines.description: The fighting shattered a brief period of calm after weeks of escalation between the U.S. and Iran over the strategic Strait of Hormuz.

headlines.title: Senate committee postpones vote on Todd Blanche’s nomination over disagreements with GOP senators
headlines.description: Two Republicans on the Judiciary Committee said they have not received the assurances they’re seeking from the Justice Department regarding the Trump-IRS settlement.

headlines.title: Todd Blanche’s rocky road: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we dig into the uncertain paths forward for Todd Blanche’s attorney general nomination and the Iran war.

headlines.title: Trump announces plans for sprawling Dulles Airport makeover
headlines.description: The plans include redoing two of the concourses and removing the airport’s aging shuttles, known as “people movers.”
